goal: I want to maintain general fitness and strength through a practical gym routine, with bike and resistance sessions. No race or maximal-strength target.
openingMessage: I've been going to the gym for years. Can you make a practical {{planSpanWeeks}}-week routine and prescribe the first {{prescriptionWeeks}} weeks?

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Maintain agreed general fitness through cycle and strength sessions, not specialist physique or race goals.
reviewAnchors.progression: Use current bike time and lifting frequency; years of gym attendance do not justify extra load.
reviewAnchors.recovery: Balance resistance and aerobic work within the stated schedule.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Complete duration-based rides with explicit RPE and practical effort instructions when usable power data is unavailable. Do not require FTP, invented watts or power zones for effort-based cycling.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Respect preferred simple separate sessions, facilities and time limits; age alone must not replace baseline evidence.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed. Unknown FTP remains unknown until an honestly labelled estimate is agreed.
